title: 第一卷 第7章 回村，我兄弟都跟镇长讲过话了！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

人民大饭店，是兰溪镇最大最好，也是消费最高的饭店。

闫振东还是第一次来人民大饭店，跟在闫耀宗身后，看起来有些心虚。

闫耀宗随便找个了位置，坐了下来，看着挂在墙上的菜单。

闫振东就读了两年小学，认识的字不多。

但，每道菜后边的价格，他都能认识。

“耀宗，这里的菜，怎么那么贵？最便宜也要两块钱？”闫振东压低声音道。

闫耀宗笑了笑，没搭理闫振东，看向走过来的女服务员。

女服务员拿着笔跟抄菜单，满脸不耐，“吃点什么？”

“一个青菜，一个小葱炒鸡蛋！”

“没了？”

“我们就两个人，太多菜，吃不下！”

“行吧。”女服务员撇撇嘴，转身离开。

没一会儿，炒青菜跟小葱炒鸡蛋就端了上来。

这鬼天气，来人民大饭店吃饭的人倒不是很多。

“确实比我娘烧的好吃！”闫振东端着碗，扒拉着白米饭跟鸡蛋。

闫耀宗闷头吃着饭。

七八分钟后，俩人干了六碗饭，青菜汤都被舔得干干净净。

闫耀宗起身去买单，一共八块五！

“真贵啊！”跟在后边的闫振东，心里边骂骂咧咧，一个炒青菜、一个小葱炒鸡蛋，居然要八块五，抢劫都没那么狠啊。

“同志，我想问下，你们这里缺不缺野货？”付完钱的闫耀宗，笑呵呵地看着坐在柜台后边的女收银员。

“小兄弟有野货？”女收银员眼睛一亮，脸上总算露出笑容，道：“不瞒你说，因为这鬼天气，我们饭店的野货断了很多天。你要是有野货，不管多少，我们统统收下！”

“对了，小兄弟怎么称呼？”

“闫耀宗！”

“好名字！”女服务员笑着自我介绍，道：“我叫刘曦乃，你叫我刘姐就行。”

“刘姐，我想长期供货，可以嘛？”闫耀宗问道。

“长期供货？”刘曦乃挑了挑眉，道：“闫兄弟，刘姐我是直肠子，有些话，就不瞒你了。我们饭店是有稳定供货商的。只不过，因为这段时间暴雨不断，供货商才断了供给。你想要上期供货，基本没可能！”

“刘姐，我们可以便宜供货！”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

The People's Hotel is the largest, best and most expensive hotel in Lanxi Town.

It was the first time for Yan Zhendong to come to the People's Hotel. He followed Yan Yaozong, looking a little guilty.

Yan Yaozong found a seat casually, sat down, and looked at the menu hanging on the wall.

Yan Zhendong attended primary school for two years and didn't know many words.

However, he can recognize the price behind each dish.

"Yao Zong, why are the dishes here so expensive? The cheapest one costs two yuan?" Yan Zhendong said in a low voice.

Yan Yaozong smiled, ignored Yan Zhendong, and looked at the waitress who came over.

The waitress took a pen and copied the menu, with an impatient look on her face, "What can I have?"

"One green vegetable, one spring onion and scrambled eggs!"

"No more?"

"There are only two of us, there are too many dishes to eat!"

"Okay." The waitress curled her lips and turned to leave.

After a while, fried vegetables and scrambled eggs with spring onions were served.

In this damn weather, not many people come to the People's Hotel to eat.

"It's indeed more delicious than what my mother cooked!" Yan Zhendong held the bowl and scooped up the white rice and eggs.

Yan Yaozong ate his meal with his head down.

Seven or eight minutes later, the two of them finished six bowls of rice, and the vegetable soup was all licked clean.

Yan Yaozong got up and went to pay the bill, a total of eight and a half yuan!

"It's so expensive!" Yan Zhendong, who was following behind, cursed in his mind. A fried green vegetable and a scrambled egg with green onions cost eight and a half yuan. The robbery was not that cruel.

"Comrade, I would like to ask, do you have any shortage of wild goods here?" After paying, Yan Yaozong looked at the female cashier sitting behind the counter with a smile.

"Little brother, do you have any wild goods?" The female cashier's eyes lit up, and a smile finally appeared on her face, and she said, "To tell you the truth, because of the bad weather, our restaurant's wild goods have been out of stock for many days. If you have any wild goods, no matter how much, we will accept them all!"

"By the way, what do you call your little brother?"

"Yan Yaozong!"

"What a name!" The waitress introduced herself with a smile and said, "My name is Liu Xi Nai, you can just call me Sister Liu."

"Sister Liu, I want to supply goods for a long time, is that okay?" Yan Yaozong asked.

"Long-term supply?" Liu Xinai raised his eyebrows and said: "Brother Yan, Sister Liu, I am a straight person, and I won't hide some things from you. Our hotel has a stable supplier. However, because of the continuous heavy rains during this period, the supplier has cut off the supply. It is basically impossible for you to supply the last period!"

"Sister Liu, we can supply it cheaply!"
